surface_mechanism_description: The silver oxide decomposed after the plasma dose step due to the high temperature of 120 /C14C and released reactive oxygen nearby the substrate surface. The reactive oxygen led to additional reactions with the following TDMAS dose step. These characteristic side reactions of the MS-ALD were exploited to generate 3D silver-silica hybrid nanostructures without the utilization of a prepatterned 3D substrate.
